responses.fb_other: The task wasn't necessarily difficult in itself, but a bit repetitive and not always super easy to get the widths lined up just right using the mouse. Sometimes they felt a bit lopsided, but maybe that was still okay. Also not sure how much noise was allowed or if those should have been peaks or not, but counted them as noise. But hopefully the ones I did were correct. Kind of interesting in a way, but more variation would have helped some.

responses.demo_ai_experience: Used Chatgpt, Gemini, Claude, Adobe Firefly and various generative AIs. Coding with javascript and C# and another C variation that nobody has heard of before (used for coding Text/Mud games). Used to know a bit of Pascal and Python but likely forgot most of it. AI primarily used for coding and artwork tasks, and cleaning up text.
